_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Statistically a coil (only 19% of recent windows moved ±2); no breaker visible yet so the skilled call is to stay on the current rung until range, funding or ETF flow actually shifts.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/coil; narrative descriptive buy imbalance + bottom pattern implies upside bias without a matching forward phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: Price holds the recent range, funding stays near flat, F&G remains 47-62, no ETF-flow impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: Range break via long liquidation (F&G under 40, funding hard negative) or ETF-flow surge that lifts sentiment into Hope
